title: Uniform and Ledger
author: Tamsin Thornbury
blurb: Isandro Whitlock, a suffragist's driver who reads every letter before delivering it, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the bridge — the only road out — closes for the season — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
